create_TorchvisionDataset: create a TorchvisionDataset adapter for CIFAR10, CIFAR100, STL10, MNIST, or SVHN with a given path and split
build_TorchvisionDataset_load: build a TorchvisionDataset instance that loads a torchvision dataset by name and split from a specified path
test_TorchvisionDataset_getitem: test the TorchvisionDataset __getitem__ method to return an image and success flag at a given index
review_TorchvisionDataset_get_labels: review the TorchvisionDataset get_labels method that returns a list of integer labels for all samples
summarize_TorchvisionDatasetName: summarize the TorchvisionDatasetName class that defines supported dataset names: CIFAR10, CIFAR100, STL10, MNIST, SVHN
